data.one_liner: A simple roulette wheel widget for lottery usage and spinning animations.
data.what_it_does: Provides customizable roulette wheel widgets with support for text, icons, and background images. Features a RouletteController to manage roll animations, physics or curve-based easing, and sector tap detection.
use_when: You need a lottery or prize wheel in your app.
You want customizable roulette sections with text, icons, or images.
avoid_when: You are building complex games requiring a general physics engine.
strengths: Easy to customize with weight-based parts, text, icons, and images.
Supports both curve-based and physics-based animations.
Includes tap detection for roulette sectors.
weaknesses: Niche widget with a single specific use case.
